label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Bankruptcy
items.text: LIV Golf filed for Chapter 11 with a $300 million pledge after Saudi funding ceased; Jon Rahm and Sergio Garcia exited via court approval, while others like Louis Oosthuizen are leaving, impacting the PGA and DP World Tours due to bans and membership restrictions.

items.headline: Tiger Woods Comeback Date
items.text: Tiger Woods is nearing a potential return to competitive golf following a major announcement confirming a comeback timeline.

items.headline: Min Woo Lee World Ranking
items.text: Min Woo Lee rose in the Official World Golf Ranking despite a recent withdrawal and health issues, while Scottie Scheffler remains number one.
